_comment: The multi-year arc. Phases are deliberately rough: only the marathon block has firm dates (they come from marathon_plan.json). Everything after it is a direction of travel, and 'approximate: true' makes the dashboard show the dates as approximate rather than stating them as fact. Edit this file freely — nothing generates it.

phases.name: Marathon

nutrition.note: Fuel the work. Day-to-day carbs follow the session; the deficit comes from easy and rest days only.

phases.notes: Firm dates — this block is defined by plan/marathon_plan.json.

phases.name: Winter bulk
phases.goal: Add muscle and strength while holding a usable aerobic base

nutrition.note: A surplus, not a free-for-all. Running drops but doesn't stop, so maintenance stays higher than a pure lifting block would.

watch: resting HR (a bulk shouldn't raise it much)
phases.notes: Starts the day after the marathon. The first 1-2 weeks are genuine recovery, not training.

phases.name: Spring cut + Ironman build

nutrition.note: A slow cut alongside rising training load. Aggressive deficits and Ironman volume don't coexist — the cut has to end well before race day.

phases.notes: End date is a placeholder until the race is entered. Set ironman_2027.date in config.json and this phase will track it.

phases.name: Speed and athleticism
phases.goal: Sprint speed, change of direction, general athleticism

nutrition.note: Around maintenance. Power work responds badly to a deficit, and this phase is also the ramp into the next bulk.

phases.notes: A deliberate change of stimulus after nine months of endurance work. Lowest injury tolerance of any phase here — tendons that have only done steady-state don't like sprinting.

phases.name: Hypertrophy and show prep

nutrition.note: The one phase where the deficit is the point rather than a side effect. Protein goes up to protect muscle; cardio becomes a tool for the deficit rather than training for anything.

phases.notes: Tight runway: a spring show wants the bulk finished and the cut starting around January, which the athleticism phase runs into. Either that phase ends early or the show moves later — worth deciding before autumn 2027.
